verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Crawl4AI can connect to proxies with authentication and retry through a proxy chain. Nothing shows a way to request a proxy by country or geolocation. Connecting to proxies you supply yourself is a user-side workaround, not a product capability for country-targeted proxies, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request a proxy from a specific country to get geolocation-appropriate content
